# Message sync reports partial additions separately from its final failure status

The extracted EWS handler reports accumulated new-message keys on both success and failure. Its folder stop callback processes those keys for new-mail state, filtering and autosync even when final status is a failure, then forwards the actual operation status to the URL listener. FolderLoaded is emitted on this stop path; it does not alone establish successful synchronization. Fixed accepted Exchange code retains this split while adding header arrays and later filtering/count behavior. No partial-failure execution was run.

Scope: exchange-message-sync.
